rationale: Canonical head of the DA to enrichment chain. map_protein_identifiers globs these and fails closed on their count; the directionality audit reads them as scientific validation; the PRIDE processed-data export sweeps the dataset directory. Declared in pipeline.yml consumes. Not work-eligible on three independent grounds.

Same contract as the forward direction, read by the reverse mapping branch and already materialized into the publication export by the gct_extractR dataset-directory sweep. The direction segment carries meaning and is preserved after the scope.

One row per comparison recording the parsed forward/reverse names, the exact files written, the GCT fields used and a per-direction computed/skipped status. That is a manifest of the extraction, not a scientific table, so it moves to manifests/. No scientific reader, but six provenance consumers address it and the export sweep reaches it.

The animal-level extraction provenance contract. map_protein_identifiers hard-gates on it via validate_canonical_gct_extract_provenance(), so it is the intra-domain contract between the two writers. It was produced but never declared before this phase; the declaration is now complete.
Run provenance. logs/ maps onto the normalized manifests/ child.

The canonical AnimalID / StressGroup / spatial-unit assignment, read as an input by nineteen analyses across wgcna, spatial_validation, differential_abundance, integration and two R/ data-contract helpers. A persistent derived scientific input, emphatically not a scratch intermediate, despite living under data/processed.
Machine-readable merge QC counts accompanying the workbook.

The most heavily depended-on object in the repository: a formally versioned file contract (docs/file_contracts.tsv, mapped_contrast_csv v4, with a named column schema), named in sixteen distinct pipeline.yml consumes entries, read by six analysis domains plus PRIDE export and eight provenance audits. Canonical scientific result.
Per-contrast mapping summaries; machine-readable, so tables/.

Per-file mapping provenance (input manifest and per-contrast mapping info). Undeclared in pipeline.yml before and after this phase, which is pre-existing registry debt recorded rather than fixed here; it moves with its writer because the destination comes from the same resolver.
Human-readable mapping reports. Also undeclared in pipeline.yml; same pre-existing debt, same resolver, so it moves with the writer rather than being left behind in a root with no producer.

A versioned serialised bundle (contract joint_compartment_qc_v1) whose top-level element set is asserted by ca_validate_bundle_reconstruction(). Four pipeline-registered QC analyses and one WGCNA audit readRDS it as an input contract, and it is named in three consumes_required entries. A .rds extension is not evidence of a cache.

The only artifact in this domain that satisfies the literal section 9 work/ rule: zero scientific, publication and provenance consumers, confirmed by two independent refutation passes that found no disqualifying evidence. It stays in results/ anyway, because it is a declared pipeline.yml produces entry validated by run_dataset_pipeline.R, and output_layout_v2 forbids any downstream contract from naming a work/ path. It is the human-readable serialization of a data frame the .rds contract already carries.

Zero in-repo readers of any kind, verified from seven independent search angles. It is nevertheless not disposable: docs/INPUT_CONTRACTS.md declares it the strict GCT v1.3 handoff consumed by the external ProTigy desktop tool, so it is an external contract boundary. Regenerable but not an intermediate.
